nodes.label: Customer Visits Retail Store
nodes.desc: Customer visits Retail store for New postpaid activation.

nodes.label: Qnomy Ticketing Process
nodes.desc: QTicket is created in Qnomy for the selected service chosen by the customer. Retail agent logs in and initiates the transaction based on the next Qnomy ticket. Agent login/authentication based on role (see AGN_AGT_360_RET_001.01).
controls: Currently an existing process; considering to remain As-Is.
Agent Login and Authentication based on Role — detailed in AGN_AGT_360_RET_001.01.

nodes.label: Automatic Trouble Ticket Creation
nodes.desc: As the agent initiates the customer onboarding process, the system automatically creates the trouble ticket and assigns it to the agent.
controls: System shall default the trouble ticket category, Type, Sub-Type.
Other mandatory fields for creating trouble ticket to be captured during design phase.

nodes.label: ID Capture (IDWise)
nodes.desc: Agent scans the customer's ID using IDWise: front page, back page, and liveliness check (optional if customer agrees). System captures customer information from the scanned ID (ID Type, ID Number, First Name, Last Name, DOB, Nationality, ID Expiry Date) and sends it to CRM.
controls: System (IDWise) shall validate the ID Type and only allow: QID, Passport, Diplomatic ID, GCC ID.
System shall allow re-scan of the ID if IDWise fails to capture information on a previous attempt.
System shall capture the Expiry Date from IDWise and populate in CRM (MOI does not return Expiry Date).

nodes.label: ID Scan Successful?
nodes.desc: Validation gate on whether IDWise successfully captured the ID information.
controls: If IDWise fails, the ID is captured manually in the system.
If MOI fails, the order is drafted but submitted later (MOI validation happens at order submission stage).

nodes.label: MOI Validation
nodes.desc: System fetches customer information from MOI based on QID, Diplomatic ID, and Passport No (from all countries). MOI returns captured fields (QID Number, 5 Name fields, DOB, Nationality, ID Expiry Date, Salutation).
controls: System shall compare MOI-returned fields with IDWise-captured fields (First Name, Last Name, ID Number, DOB).
If all fields match (100%) agent may proceed; else agent can reject or re-scan (from ID Capture).
MOI can be fetched on Diplomatic ID; GCC ID number validation happens for MOI; only prepaid for GCC ID and Passport.
Expiry Date currently defaults to today's date + 365 days; IDWise needs to send Expiry date.

nodes.label: MOI Fields Match IDWise?
nodes.desc: Decision on whether MOI-returned fields match IDWise-captured fields at 100%.
controls: 3. If all fields match (100%) then agent shall be allowed to proceed else agent can reject or re-scan (from ID Capture).

nodes.label: Existing Customer Check
nodes.desc: System verifies if the customer already exists or needs to be created as a new customer, based on ID Type and ID Number.
controls: If ID Type and ID Number match an existing customer record, the system displays the relevant customer information.
If ID Type/ID Number don't match any existing customer record, the system creates a new customer.
Only MOI validation checks the ID Status; no override happens for any fields other than Expiry Date and MOI validation Timestamp.

nodes.label: Customer Creation
nodes.desc: Post MOI validation success and customer eligibility, customer-specific fields are displayed on UI (non-editable). Address from MOI is editable. Agent populates mandatory customer account fields (Account Type, Customer Category, Segment).
controls: System shall create a default Primary contact based on customer information.
System shall populate the default credit limit based on customer's segment.
System shall allow the agent to override Email, Language, and Alternate Phone #.
System shall capture the ID Expiry Date from IDWise (scanned ID) and populate the field on UI.

nodes.label: HRN Check
nodes.desc: System displays HRN information for the customer based on nationality information received from MOI.
controls: Based on nationality from MOI, system flags the customer as HRN.
System displays a message on the customer creation page for advance payment: "(HRN) Customer needs to pay advance payment of QR 50."

nodes.label: Contact Creation
nodes.desc: System allows adding multiple contacts to one customer and allows assigning roles to each created contact.

nodes.label: Email Verification
nodes.desc: Agent captures the Email Address and verifies it, marking it as verified through an email verification mechanism.
controls: Currently ZeroBounce is used to verify email (outside of system); only Retail agents use ZeroBounce.

nodes.label: Customer Eligibility (ID Type & Age)
nodes.desc: Agent validates customer eligibility based on ID type and validates the customer's age as 18 years. If not eligible, a validation message is displayed on the UI.
controls: Journey allowed by ID type: QID = Postpaid & Prepaid; Passport = Prepaid; GCC ID = Prepaid; Diplomatic ID = Prepaid & Postpaid.
ID Status rules: Active (QID/Passport/GCC/Diplomatic) = New connection/Modification; Expired (QID) = only modifications; Expired (Passport/GCC/Diplomatic) = No action allowed.
No system validation currently enforced for age (per VFQ response).

nodes.label: Blacklisted / In-Collections Check
nodes.desc: System validates current outstanding dues; agent asks customer to clear dues if any before proceeding.
controls: If customer status is "In Collections", system shall not allow agent to proceed.
System shall not allow proceeding if customer dues are above the threshold limit (10 QAR; 100 QAR for HRN).
If customer status is "Blacklisted", system shall not allow agent to proceed.

nodes.label: Line Count Check
nodes.desc: System validates the total active connections associated with the customer; blocks the agent if the line count limit is reached, unless a credit-team approval task is created.
controls: Qatari nationals are not restricted by line count limit.
QID holders (Expats) can have up to 5 mobile voice connections, all postpaid.
An Expat customer can take more than 2 postpaid connections (between 3-5) only with credit team approval.
System creates an approval task for the credit team if an expat customer requests more than 2 postpaid connections.
Agent may capture and hold the order for submission until the approval task is approved; agent may cancel the order if the approval task is rejected.

nodes.label: Credit Team Approval Task
nodes.desc: Approval task routed to the credit team when an expat customer exceeds 2 postpaid connections; agent holds order until approved or cancels if rejected.
controls: Agent shall be able to cancel the order if the approval task is rejected.

nodes.label: Save Journey Milestone
nodes.desc: System saves the journey milestone upon successful validation.
controls: System shall save the journey milestone upon successful validation.

nodes.label: Credit Limit Enhancement (Privileged Agents)
nodes.desc: System allows modification of the system-defaulted credit limit, restricted to Privileged agents.
controls: Additional delta amount of credit limit must be paid by customer as a deposit, refunded after disconnection from service.
Any agent can update credit limit from 50 to 1000 for Expat; otherwise routed to credit control team via ticket for manual update.
Collections role has access to update credit limit.

nodes.label: Journey Stopped — Not Eligible / Blocked
nodes.desc: Customer is not eligible for activation (age/ID type) or is blocked (blacklisted / in collections above threshold); journey does not proceed.

nodes.label: Billing Profile Setup
nodes.desc: Agent captures Billing Profile details and selects the Billing Address: use customer address, or capture a new billing address.
controls: One customer can have multiple billing accounts and billing profiles.
One billing profile can have only one active payment profile.
One billing profile can have multiple billing contacts — one primary, others secondary.
Bill invoice shall be sent to the primary billing contact.

nodes.label: Cart Eligibility — Base Plan, Add-ons, Discounts
nodes.desc: Agent selects only eligible base plans, then selects add-ons and discounts based on the selected base plan.
controls: Eligibility of base plans is based on customer segment and connection type (Postpaid/Prepaid).
System shall only allow eligible add-ons on the base plan and prevent non-eligible add-ons.
System shall enforce add-on cardinality rules (minimum/maximum, default quantity) as configured.
System shall only allow eligible discounts on the base plan.

nodes.label: Privileged Cart Eligibility
nodes.desc: Agents with special roles can provide specific add-ons/discounts (e.g. Vodafone for All) attaching the customer's MADA ID to the form.
controls: System will allow only the highest discount % to the cart and removes all other discounts.
System will allow Preconfigured Add-On and Privileged Add-on both to be added to the cart.
Currently all agents can provide special discounts, so extra-privilege roles are not required (per VFQ response).

nodes.label: Cart (Order) Creation
nodes.desc: Agent creates the cart (order) with base plan, add-ons, and discounts; reviews and modifies selected plans/add-ons before submission.
controls: System shall display the Bill Limit of the plan as per the Account Credit Limit.
System shall recalculate cart charges, recurring charges, one-time charges, discounts whenever products are added/modified/removed.
System should apply the latest discount to the cart.

nodes.label: Save Journey Milestone
nodes.desc: System saves the journey milestone upon successful validation.
controls: System shall save the journey milestone upon successful validation.

nodes.label: Reserved Number Selection
nodes.desc: Agent reserves a number, or views/selects an existing reserved number for the customer.
controls: System shall verify whether the customer has an active reserved number (via telesales or other channel) based on QID.
System shall display and allow reservation of a number based on the selected plan.
System shall validate the reserved number price against the selected Base Plan Price; delta added to cart if higher.
System shall reserve the selected MSISDN upon confirmation to prevent allocation elsewhere.
Reserved Number is unlocked after 72 hours if not used by the same customer.
Display sequence: 1. Reserved (auto-populate), 2. Star Number, 3. Free Number.

nodes.label: Star Number Selection
nodes.desc: Agent searches and selects an MSISDN from the Star Number List, reviews category/charges, and confirms selection.
controls: System shall display available Star Number category numbers with applicable prices and upfront charges.
Discounts for star numbers depend on the base plan value selected.
System shall display the Lock-In Period applicable for Star Number.
Display of numbers should be highest to lowest price range.

nodes.label: Free Number Selection
nodes.desc: Agent searches and selects an MSISDN from the Free Number List and adds it to the cart.
controls: System shall display the available numbers from the Free Number category.

nodes.label: SIM Allocation
nodes.desc: Agent selects a SIM option (Physical SIM, eSIM, Virtual eSIM), scans/assigns or generates the SIM, and associates it with the cart. System validates and reserves SIM inventory. Agent may also capture SIM Swap reason (Lost/Faulty/eSIM) for a SIM Swap journey.
controls: System shall validate and allocate SIM inventory based on SIM Type and inventory availability.
System shall reserve the scanned SIM into the inventory system.
In case of eSIM selected, the virtual eSIM shall also be sent over email.

nodes.label: Key Information Display
nodes.desc: System displays Key Terms and Conditions in the UI (varying by channel, agent, and service type) — Plan Selected, Plan Lock-In Period, Star Number, Star Lock-In Period, Device on Installment, DOI Lock-In Period — before CAF submission.
controls: These details must be shown to the agent before CAF submission.
Final Cart and Key Information must match; any cart change before submission must be reflected in the CAF submission Key Information shown to the agent.

nodes.label: CAF Generate
nodes.desc: Agent generates the Digital CAF for the customer based on the mapped template.
controls: System shall generate the CAF based on a pre-configured template, based on Product Type and Service Type.

nodes.label: CAF Submission
nodes.desc: Agent selects and uploads CAF documents manually (offline signed - paper CAF) or selects the Digital CAF option (online signed).
controls: CAF can be uploaded in PDF or JPG format, with a maximum file size of 2 MB per document.

nodes.label: Signature Pad — Customer Signs CAF
nodes.desc: Agent selects CAF option (Digital touchpad or Touch Screen laptop); customer signs the CAF form at the counter; system displays the CAF form and captures the signature; agent attaches supporting documents if any.
controls: Supporting documents can be uploaded in PDF or JPG format, with a maximum file size of 2 MB per document.

nodes.label: Supporting Documents Upload
nodes.desc: Agent attaches any supporting documents required for the activation process. If special discounts (Vodafone for All) are added, agent uploads MADA ID as a supporting document. System displays uploaded documents in a separate section, viewable/downloadable.
controls: Supporting documents can be uploaded in PDF or JPG format, with a maximum file size of 2 MB per document.

nodes.label: Save Journey Milestone
nodes.desc: System saves the journey milestone upon successful validation.
controls: System shall save the journey milestone upon successful validation.

nodes.label: Validate Cart
nodes.desc: Agent reviews and validates the cart before proceeding to payment.
controls: System shall perform all customer, account, billing, number, SIM, product, eligibility, compatibility validations prior to payment initiation.
System shall prevent order progression until all mandatory validations are successfully completed.

nodes.label: Payment Processing (WinCash)
nodes.desc: Agent views the payment summary and initiates payment through WinCash for base plan price, add-on charges, star number premium, and HRN advance payment. Agent provides the customer a receipt generated by WinCash (including zero-payment receipts).
controls: System shall display the payment summary and total payable amount prior to payment processing.
System shall capture and process any upfront applicable charges (star number/HRN deposit).
System shall capture and process bill payments to the billing system.
System shall send the upfront payment request to WinCash and update payment status in CRM based on the response.
If payment fails, the system shall place the order on hold and return the agent to the payment summary screen for re-attempt.
Advance payments are adjusted in the 1st bill.

nodes.label: Payment Successful?
nodes.desc: Gate on WinCash payment response.
controls: If payment fails, the system shall place the order on hold and return the agent to the payment summary screen for re-attempt.

nodes.label: Inventory Depletion
nodes.desc: WinCash depletes the physical SIM/Printed eSIM from stock. For Virtual eSIM, the system depletes from the inventory (UIM), since Virtual eSIMs are not maintained through WinCash.

nodes.label: Order Submission and Activation
nodes.desc: Agent submits the order and creates an Activity in the UI describing the order-specific details for other advisors' reference.
controls: System shall submit the order to downstream systems for backend provisioning and activation if payment is successful.

nodes.label: All Orders View from Customer 360
nodes.desc: System navigates the agent to Customer 360 -> All Orders View after the order is submitted to downstream systems; agent can view a particular order's detailed view.

nodes.label: Customer Notification — Submission
nodes.desc: System sends an order submission notification to the customer through the selected mode (Email/SMS).

nodes.label: Order Completion
nodes.desc: Agent informs the customer that the postpaid activation SLA is 4 business hours after successful order confirmation. System receives order completion from downstream systems into CRM once activation and provisioning are completed.

nodes.label: Trouble Ticket Update — Resolved
nodes.desc: Once the order status is completed in CRM (all provisioning and activation done), system updates the ticket to "Resolved" status.
controls: System shall update the Order Number in the Trouble Ticket details.
System shall update the mandatory fields while making the TT status Resolved.

nodes.label: Feedback Survey (Medallia)
nodes.desc: Once the order is completed, system sends the information to Medallia to send the Customer Feedback Survey, and receives the Survey Status from Medallia in CRM.
controls: System shall keep the trouble ticket in Resolved status until the Survey is not completed.

nodes.label: Trouble Ticket Closure
nodes.desc: System automatically marks the Trouble Ticket as Closed and closes all Activities of the Trouble Ticket once the Customer Feedback link is sent.

nodes.label: Customer Notification — Completion
nodes.desc: System sends an acknowledgement of order completion to the customer through the selected mode (Email/SMS), and sends notification to all MSISDNs available under the QID.
controls: All numbers against the QID receive an activation notification for a new number (CRA requirement).

nodes.label: Prepaid Activation Complete
nodes.desc: Postpaid/prepaid mobile activation journey completed — trouble ticket closed and customer notified.
